recipes.name: Chicken Alfredo
ingredients_raw: 2 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - cooked and cubed

steps.text: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta, and cook for 8 to 10 minutes, or until al dente; drain.

While pasta is cooking, melt cream cheese and butter in a skillet over low heat. Stir until smooth. Stir in milk, and season with garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Simmer for 3 minutes, or until thickened, stirring constantly.

Mix in chicken, broccoli, zucchini, and red pepper. Cook 3 minutes over medium heat, then reduce heat, and simmer 5 minutes, or until vegetables are tender. Serve hot over fettuccine and top with grated Parmesan cheese.

raw_recipe.headline: Chicken Alfredo
raw_recipe.description: A quick and easy chicken Alfredo dinner with broccoli, zucchini, and red bell pepper. The sauce is enriched by cream cheese.

review.reviewBody: The easy fix is what makes this recipe a winner. This is barely enough sauce for more than 2 diners and I have to serve 4, so I used 12 oz cream cheese, 1/2 cup butter,1 c milk. I cooked the red peppers with the chicken. I also tossed the broccoli in to cook with the pasta so it would be "easier" on the kids, skipped the zucchini, and topped off w/parmesan.

Loved making the sauce from scratch; way better than any bottled Alfredo sauce. Made it for a crowd of 30 with diced red peppers, shallots, wilted spinach and petite green peas and despite a veggie-averse mob, it had them coming back for seconds. This is delicious with whatever vegetables you might have on hand like sautéed zucchini, mushrooms or asparagus, steamed broccoli or carrots and/or diced tomatoes. The key component is the sauce here, so get that right and you can mix and match the pasta and veggie selection. Will certainly make it again and it does scale up for a big crowd quite easily.

I did use quite a bit more milk than called for so that I could pre-assemble and bake casserole-style for serving.

Used penne pasta, 16 oz of cream cheese and 1 1/2 cups milk (bumped up amount for 10 servings). Plenty of sauce and delicious!! I cooked red pepper and broccoli for few minutes after chicken was done (in leftover seasoning and canola oil). It was perfectly done. My picky eaters inhaled this dish! This has a homemade taste without turning you off.

I followed the recipe, as stated, minus zucchini. I got nervous that there wouldn't be enough 'sauce', mainly since I cut up way too many veggies, so I quickly doubled the sauce amounts. Also, at first the cream cheese and butter were mixing more like oil and water, but i increased the heat a little, and kept stirring, and it finally mixed together into a cream. This recipe turned out fantastic! Definitely a new favorite! Thank you for sharing. Edit: this is way better with real minced garlic. I add about 4 small cloves or 3 large ones with the sauce once it smooths out. I make this at least once a month now.

To make it low carb and because my husband was not sure about the veges I steamed the veges and served them on the side. I added carrots and poured the sauce over the veges no pasta for me. I also sauteed some mushrooms with garlic and olive oil on the side. I did double the sauce. Easy ane wonderful!
I made this and also added 1/2 C freshly graded Parmesan cheese. Delish!!!

I like this recipe, it's very easy and quick, and delicious. I cook this dish for two and also substitute few things what's only makes this dish better. I use 4 oz angel hair pasta, 4 oz cream cheese, 350 ml half & half, 3 tbsp butter, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1/2 tsp roasted garlic slices, 1/2 tsp basil, salt+pepper, zucchini and broccoli 1 cup of each. I marinated one big chicken breast in Italian seasoning and pesto (salt+pepper) for 15 min, then cook it on skillet, it's comes juicy and good flavored. Put all together as on this recipe and enjoy dinner)))

My whole family enjoyed this! I did what others suggested and used just under 1/2c butter; 12oz cream cheese (at room temperature) and added parmesan cheese and aged gouda to the sauce. As well, I added a dash or two of cayenne pepper. Next time I will use unsalted butter. I found it a bit salty.

I made it exactly as the recipe called and it was rather bland. I decided to add 1/2 c parmesan cheese, 1/2 c chicken stock, 1/2 tsp more garlic powder, salt and pepper. It was a super hit! I must say, it is one of the best Chicken Alfredo w/fettuccini I've had in a long time. I did really like the cream cheese is a great idea. It gave the sauce a creamy smooth consistency. My husband really like that as well.

So very good! I substituted mushrooms for the red peppers and used a pasta other than fettuccini. Added the pasta and cheese in the skillet before serving. I have no idea why some cooks didn't have enough sauce, I had so much.

I made the recipe nearly as written, and I slightly changed how the vegetables were cooked. After cooking my chicken, I added the vegetables and sauteed them before adding them to the sauce. In addition, I doubled the amount of pasta and sauce. I had more than enough vegetables in a single serving. The overall recipe was okay, but on the blander side. It is a cream cheese sauce that is only seasoned with some garlic powder, salt, and pepper, though. In addition, I would have added some Parmesan to the sauce to help get rid of the cream cheese taste. It is a good starter recipe, but could use some tweaks to make it better.
This is a really good even without the Alfredo sauce and you making your own sauce for it. I really enjoyed it. Thanks for the recipe
Looovvve itttt❤️‍🔥
Use fresh garlic for authentic taste and double the milk for extra sauce if you can, otherwise it’s very yummy
I substituted half and half for milk. Very tasty and rich.
Loved it.
No changes were made and this was an excellent dish!
Easy recipe. The cream cheese and butter didn't melt together to a creamy consistency as the recipe calls for, but I continued and added the milk and it came together very creamy then.

It seemed a little salty but that could have been my fault. Once I put it on the noodles it was much better. We liked it. I would use less butter next time. I took some off because it looked greasy. It was hard to get smooth but the milk really helped. We would recommend trying it. :)
This recipe is so easy and quick. I don't care for red peppers so just eliminated them.
